name: application-rep-counter-ring
title: Rep Counter Ring
description: Circular rep-count and rest-timer ring components for workout tracking apps, showing progress toward a target with a live countdown.
useWhen: Circular rep-count and rest-timer ring components for workout tracking apps, showing progress toward a target with a live countdown.
avoidWhen: Avoid rep counter ring when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Rep Counter Ring uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
